text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: The aim of this major is to cultivate high-level talents. This program provides talents to serve for the region's foreign economic relations, foreign trade, foreign investment, and the strategy of "going out". The major combines international economics and trade theories, policies with business practices closely. Students are required broader knowledge theoretically and politically along with better English skill and operational international trade ability. 2. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: The model of this program is 2+2. It takes 4-6 years to complete this program generally. International students can start their major directly after they come to China. In the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes with Chinese peers for Chinese-medium courses. 3. Internship Editor Notes: Internship in companies are provided in this program. Students can have up to 12-weeks internship in companies under the guidance of professors. 4. Language Requirement Editor Notes: International students are required to pass HSK 4 before graduation. English-speaking international students don't need pass HSK (Chinese proficiency test) to start degree programs. However they need to pass HSK 4 at the end of second year of their degree programs. 5. Main Research Fields Editor Notes: There are 3 kinds of research fields in this program. 1.International economics trade theory and policy (1) International service trade (2) New theories of international economics and trade (3) Trade and environment (4) Multinational companies and international trade 2.Forestry products trade (1)International trade practice of forestry products (2) Forestry products trade theories 3.International trade practice 6. Introduction of Zhejiang A & F University Editor Notes: The first employment rate of undergraduate students is always more than 90% and in the forefront of Zhejiang universities. Founded in 1958, Zhejiang A & F University (ZAFU) is a comprehensive university directly under the auspices of Zhejiang Province offering Bachelor and Masters degrees in agriculture, technology, science, literature, management, law, economics, medicine, etc. and enrolling international students. ZAFU, located in Lin'an City (west of the popular tourist destination Hangzhou) has Yijin and East Lake campuses covering almost 167 hectares with 550,000 square meters of building space. Its modern buildings and facilities in a setting of great natural beauty, surrounded by mountains and water, make ZAFU a most suitable place for learning, teaching, and conducting research. The campus combined with the botanical garden comprise an ecological environment with functions of teaching, scientific research, and biodiversity conservation. Learn More>> 7.
